title: Bug or Feature$^2$: Weight Drift and Activation Sparsity
abstract: arXiv:2605.17659v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The design of modern neural architectures has converged through incremental empirical choices, yet the mechanisms governing their training dynamics remain only partially understood. We identify and analyze a negative weight drift induced by the interaction between standard losses and positively biased activation functions. We prove that under MSE or cross-entropy loss, the gradient with respect to positive pre-activations is non-negative in expectation at initialization, driving downstream weights toward negative values during early training. The drift is intrinsic to optimization rather than data, and persists across architectures and asymmetric activation functions (ReLU, GELU, SiLU). Coupled with ReLU, weight drift produces activation sparsity reaching nearly 90% in GPT-nano. translated_title: 缺陷还是特性²：权重漂移与激活稀疏性
translated_abstract: 现代神经架构的设计是通过渐进式的经验性选择逐步收敛而来的，然而其训练动态背后的机制至今仍只被部分理解。我们识别并分析了一种由标准损失函数与正向偏置激活函数之间相互作用所引发的负向权重漂移。我们证明，在MSE或交叉熵损失下，初始化时对正预激活值的梯度期望为非负，这会在训练早期推动下游权重趋向负值。这种漂移是优化过程本身固有的，而非源于数据，并且在各种架构和非对称激活函数（ReLU、GELU、SiLU）中都持续存在。与ReLU结合时，权重漂移在GPT-nano中产生了接近90%的激活稀疏性。我们进一步分析了这种自然产生的稀疏性是否有害，发现平均而言，当激活稀疏度超过约70%时，模型性能会急剧退化。
tldr: 本文揭示了标准损失函数与正向偏置激活函数的相互作用会引发优化过程中固有的负向权重漂移，进而在训练早期自发产生高达约90%的激活稀疏性，并发现当激活稀疏度超过约70%时模型性能会急剧退化。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that the interaction between standard losses and positively biased activation functions induces an intrinsic negative weight drift during optimization, naturally producing activation sparsity of up to ~90% in early training, and finds that models sharply degrade once activation sparsity exceeds ~70%.
